title_sq: Ne Qytet Studenti, Shitet Dyqan Duplex I Pershtatshem Per Tipologji Te Ndryshme Biznesi !!
description_sq: Ne Qytet Studenti, Shitet Dyqan Duplex I Pershtatshem Per Tipologji Te Ndryshme Biznesi. title_en: In the city of Studenti, a duplex store is for sale, suitable for different types of business!!
description_en: In Student City, Duplex Store for Sale, Suitable for Different Types of Business. The shop has a net area of ​​78 m2 and is located in one of the well-managed buildings of 2013 with an open space organization turned into a duplex due to the favorable height it has. The glass facade is also an added value of the store due to the lighting and the possibility of branding or advertising of the business that can be operated. The store is accessed from both sides with doors that make it suitable for different types of business. The area in which the environment is located is one of the most sought after in Tirana.
